title: field read-redaction — `mask unless` crossed with `audited` (two masked fields + a masked contained part, projected twice in one scope)
note: the CROSSING is the point: an audited op renders the masked projection twice into one method body, which is where a fixed principal-variable name collides (.NET CS0128)

apiCaller.//: The same entity-history read class: `field-mask` reads its audited aggregate's trail as the unprivileged principal (the masked-field DROP and the RS-45 `actor`).
